name: P0 (Must-Have)
guidance: Complete fully before moving to the next module; anything blocked on it stays blocked.

name: P1 (Core Competency)
meaning: Essential patterns, standard-library tools, common production workflows
guidance: Build small practice projects until the pattern is automatic; these make you employable.

name: P2 (Advanced / Specialized)
guidance: Do after the module is otherwise complete; useful for senior-role and specialized tracks.
